description: Gradient dark pill gray button that starts animating on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, starts the rotcirclegr animation (rotating).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Slimy Jellyfish 95</title>
<style>
/* Slimy Jellyfish 95 by mrhyddenn — https://uiverse.io/mrhyddenn/slimy-jellyfish-95 */
button {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 100px;
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
  height: 100px;
  border-radius: 100px;
  border: none;
  background: #333;
  color: #e5e5e5;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: inset 20px 20px 39px #080a10,
  inset -20px -20px 39px #1b263e;
  font-size: 13px;
}

button::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  z-index: -1;
  left: -10px;
  top: -10px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  width: calc(100% + 20px);
  height: calc(100% + 20px);
  background: linear-gradient(35deg, rgb(47, 190, 238), rgb(218, 57, 143), rgb(139, 255, 23));
  filter: blur(10px);
}

button:hover::after {
  animation: rotcirclegr 1s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes rotcirclegr {
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
    Hover me!
</button>

</body>
</html>
